hero.html:
Level 3 - Intermediate Read 60 minBuild 120 min Machine-coding case study Patterns: State table, Strategy, Specification, Observer, Facade

Task Tracker (Jira, Trello, To-Do)

One problem in three costumes: the PhonePe "task tracker with an activity log", the Amazon "tasks and subtasks" round and the Flipkart "Trello" machine-coding problem. You get one design that covers all three: boards and members, issues with subtasks, a configurable workflow with guards, sprints, composable filters, an append-only audit log and a version check against lost updates. The code runs in Java, Python and C++14 and prints the same output.
